To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Menendez <cmenendez@aderahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo environment expiring — procurement routing delay

Hi Rishi,

Quick note — procurement is still routing the PO and legal flagged a few contract items for signature. Finance says they need another 4-6 business days to finalize. The sandbox timer for our eval is set to expire next Wednesday and our engineering team is in the middle of an integration spike.

Can Redwood do anything short-term so we don't lose momentum? We can't commit yet without the PO, but losing the environment would mean redoing a bunch of work.

Thanks,
Elena

Director of Platform Engineering
Adera Health

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo environment expiring — procurement routing delay

Thanks for the heads up, Elena — really appreciate the transparency.

We can offer a short stopgap: a one-time 7-day extension of full demo access while your PO completes routing. It's an administrative toggle on our side (no billing until the PO is processed) but I need an internal sign-off from Finance to confirm we can waive charges for that window.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll loop in our operations/finance lead for approval (quick ask).
- Camila (cc) from Solutions will stay on the thread to make sure the environment remains reachable and to document any metrics you want preserved.

If you prefer credits instead of a free extension, let me know — we can structure it either way, but the free 7-day pause is usually faster.

Would a 7-day extension cover the procurement timeline on your side?

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Elena, Rishi — happy to help on the operational side.

We can suspend the sandbox expiry timer and snapshot your current workspace so nothing is lost. For transparency, the options are:
- Free 7-day stopgap access (no billing in that window) — fastest to enable
- 7-day token voucher (applied after PO clears) — small accounting step for both sides

If you confirm the 7-day free option, I'll create the snapshot, extend access, and add a note to your workspace with the PO number once it's available.

If procurement expects more than a week, say so now and we can look at a staged approach (7 days + optional 7-day extension pending finance approval).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Rishi — Finance / Commercial has reviewed the ask. Approve a one-time 7-calendar-day complimentary hold for Adera Health under these conditions:
- PO expected within 10 business days and a named procurement contact is provided (we have Elena and Carlos on thread).
- No additional extensions without an approval from Commercial.
- We will preserve logs and snapshot the workspace; any TB-level data retention beyond snapshot must be requested separately.

Camila — you have go-ahead to flip the toggle and document the change in the deal record. I'll update the HubSpot note and mark this as a special concession (discount code not applied).

Marissa Cole
